page.title: Student Display Settings
page.description: Control what learners see — sidebar, courses, login, certificates, notifications and more.

sidebar.appLinksLabel: Show app download links in the sidebar
sidebar.appLinksHelp: Turn this off to move the app downloads to the dashboard “Get the app” widget instead. Links come from the domain routing settings.
sidebar.cardDescription: Toggle entire sidebar and configure tabs, order and visibility

ui.cardDescription: Select the visual theme for learner portal
ui.movedToAppearance: The theme skin now lives in Settings → Appearance, together with corner style, density and surface style.

widgets.cardDescription: Hide/Unhide, order and add custom widgets
widgets.subTitle: Sub Title

loginSignup.cardDescription: Providers and defaults for student signup
loginSignup.masterToggleHint: Master toggle: when off, "Sign Up" links are hidden in the catalogue header.
loginSignup.usernameFieldEmpty: No text, number or phone fields yet. Add one in Custom Fields.
loginSignup.usernameFieldNotRequired: "{{field}}" is optional — learners who leave it empty get the usual username.
loginSignup.usernamePrefixHint: Optional. Usernames are unique across all institutes, so a prefix avoids clashes.
loginSignup.usernameApplyToAllHint: Off: learner signup only. On: also admin add, CSV upload, invite links, payments and forms.
loginSignup.usernameOverrideTypedHint: On: admin add and CSV use this rule even when a username is typed; the username box is locked.
loginSignup.usernamePreviewNone: New learners get a generated or self-chosen username.
loginSignup.usernameRulesNote: Only new learners — existing usernames never change. A username an admin types always wins, a taken one gets a short suffix, and an empty value falls back to the usual username.

courseSettings.hideRepeatedTitle: Hide the assignment title when it repeats the slide name

profilePage.cardDescription: What learners see on their Profile tab

courseDetails.cardDescription: Tabs, default tab and view preferences
courseDetails.contentCardArtworkHint: How subject, module and chapter thumbnails fit their card. Choose Fill for photos; choose Fit Whole Image when your artwork has a title designed into it, which Fill crops off.
courseDetails.fitFill: Fill the card (crops to fit) — default
courseDetails.chapterOpensFirstSlide: Chapter Card Opens the First Slide Directly
courseDetails.showTeachersHint: The first author is always shown with their photo, subtitle and bio. Turn this on to list every teacher assigned to the batch. Email addresses are never shown to learners.
courseDetails.hideTags: Hide the course tags (ENGLISH, E-LEARNING…) above the title
courseDetails.markCompleteButton: "Mark as Complete" Button in Slide Viewer
courseDetails.collapseAppSidebar: Collapse App Sidebar in Slide Viewer

allCourses.pageSize: Courses per page on the All Courses list
allCourses.showAllEnrolledOnDashboard: Dashboard "My courses": show every enrolled course, not just the first 4
allCourses.customTabTags: Show courses with any of these tags
allCourses.customTabIncomplete: Learners won't see this tab until it has a label and something to show.
allCourses.customTabNoTags: No course tags yet. Add tags to courses first, then pick them here.

customTabTypeHints.LIVE_SESSIONS: Live and upcoming sessions the learner can join, including public webinars.
customTabTypeHints.FREE_COURSES: Every catalogue course whose price is 0 — updates on its own.
customTabTypeHints.COURSES: Only the courses you pick. A course must be published to the catalogue to appear.
customTabTypeHints.PRODUCT_PAGES: A card for each product page; tapping it opens the page.
customTabTypeHints.TAG: Catalogue courses carrying any of the chosen tags.

liveClasses.cardDescription: What learners can see about past live sessions
liveClasses.showUnassignedPublicSessions: Show public classes with no batch to all enrolled learners
liveClasses.showUnassignedPublicSessionsHint: Public classes not assigned to any batch or learner appear in every enrolled learner's Live Classes list.

tutorials.cardDescription: Guided step-by-step tours {{learnerPlural}} can replay from their Help menu
tutorials.pdfGuideHint: Let {{learnerPlural}} download a branded step-by-step PDF from their Help menu. Chapters follow the tours checked above.
tutorials.pdfGuideError: Could not generate the guide PDF. Please try again.

concentration.cardDescription: A periodic prompt over video lessons asking {{learnerPlural}} to tap a highlighted number, used to measure the concentration score
concentration.frequencyHint: Each check appears at a random point between these two gaps.

postLoginRedirect.cardDescription: Route to redirect student after login

enrolledLayout.title: Page Layout (After Enrollment)
enrolledLayout.hint: Applies to the learner's own course page — the one they open from their courses after enrolling. The public catalogue always shows the full page.
enrolledLayout.fullDescription: Banner, description and tags, course highlights, the enrollment/configuration block and the right-hand overview card (author, duration, counts) — plus every tab you have made visible below.
enrolledLayout.contentOnlyDescription: Just the title and the <1>Content Structure</1> card. No description, tags, banner, highlights or right-hand card. Opening the card drills <3>Subject → Module → Chapter</3> as large cards, then the slides open in the viewer. The tab, outline and overview settings below stop applying to enrolled learners.

sidebarNav.title: Sidebar Navigation
sidebarNav.hint: Controls how the learner moves across subjects, modules and chapters from the slide viewer. Each option changes what the left sidebar shows — pick whichever fits your learners' mental model.
sidebarNav.breadcrumbDescription: Sidebar lists <1>only the current chapter's slides</1>. To jump to another module or subject, the learner taps the breadcrumb at the top and picks from a dropdown. Best when courses are small or you want learners focused on the current chapter.
sidebarNav.treeDescription: Sidebar shows the <1>entire Subject → Module → Chapter → Slide tree</1>. Learners can scan, expand and jump to any slide without leaving the viewer. The breadcrumb becomes a passive label. Best for longer courses where side-by-side discovery matters.
sidebarNav.lessonsDescription: The whole course as a <1>flat list of lessons</1>, each with a thumbnail, a full two-line title and its length. Chapters become headings rather than toggles, so nothing has to be expanded, and a course-wide progress bar sits at the top. Best for courses learners work through in order.
sidebarNav.hiddenDescription: The viewer shows <1>only the slide</1>. Learners move with the <3>Previous / Next</3> buttons above the content, which roll over into the next or previous chapter at the edges. Best when you want a single, guided path with nothing to browse past.
